# Phase 1 — Auto-Generated Submission Packages (Sprint 20)

> Every free listing target from `growth/15-backlink-opportunities.md` gets a ready-to-paste submission package. **Shared copy is defined once below** (Section A); each target card (Section B) lists the site-specific fields: submission channel, category fit, title variant, and notes. Copy the shared copy + card fields, paste into the form, submit, and update `growth/19-backlink-tracking.csv`.
>
> **Live submission is the manual step** — packages below are generated and ready; no package requires any further writing.

---

## Section A — Shared Copy (copy-paste ready)

**A1. Title (primary):** PilotStack — Independent Software Reviews & Comparisons
**A2. Title (alt):** PilotStack | Trusted Software Reviews, Comparisons & Guides
**A3. Short description (≤160 chars):**
Independent software reviews, expert comparisons, and actionable guides. Hands-on, two-week testing with a transparent rubric — free for all software buyers.
**A4. Medium description (≤500 chars):**
PilotStack is an independent software review and research platform that helps businesses make confident software purchasing decisions. Founded in 2024, our small, independent team tests every tool hands-on for a minimum of two weeks before publishing a rating — scoring features, ease of use, support, value, and performance on a transparent 1–5 rubric. With 695+ research pages, 150+ in-depth reviews, 600+ side-by-side comparisons, and 12 major software categories covered, PilotStack offers in-depth reviews, side-by-side comparisons, and practical buying guides. Our editorial independence policy guarantees that no vendor can influence ratings. Free for all readers.
**A5. Company bio (≤100 words):**
PilotStack is an independent software review and research platform founded in 2024. Our small, independent team tests every tool hands-on for two weeks before rating it — scoring features, ease of use, support, value, and performance on a transparent rubric. No vendor can pay for placement. With 695+ research pages, 600+ side-by-side comparisons, 150+ in-depth reviews, and 12 categories covered, we help businesses research, compare, and buy software with confidence. Free for all readers.
**A6. Tags:** software reviews, saas reviews, software comparison, b2b software, software buying guide, saas directory, product reviews, software selection, vendor evaluation, tech stack research, software benchmarks, buyer research, expert reviews, editorial independence
**A7. URL:** https://www.pilotstack.online
**A8. Social:** X @pilotstackon · LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/pilotstack · GitHub github.com/pilotstack
**A9. Logo assets:** `/brand-assets` (primary PNG, icon, horizontal lockup, white/mono variants) — 512px min, transparent.
**A10. Screenshots:** homepage, review page, comparison page, best-of page, research page (desktop + 375px mobile) per checklist in `growth/16-submission-assets.md`.

## Submission Workflow (per target)

1. Open the tracker row (`growth/19-backlink-tracking.csv`) → confirm status is `Package Ready`.
2. Open the target card above; paste A-copy + card-specific fields into the form.
3. Attach logo (A9) and screenshots (A10) where supported.
4. Submit → set status `Submitted` + date in the tracker.
5. After approval/rejection → set `Approved`/`Rejected` and record `link_url` + `anchor_text` on approval.

## Status Legend (tracker)

`Package Ready` → generated this sprint, not yet submitted · `Submitted` → form sent · `Pending` → under review · `Approved` → live link recorded · `Rejected` → denied, archive row
